_comment: zw-brain design-contract stats only. sync-stats lives in scripts/ for CI without an external dev-rules checkout.

zwbrain.webui-pages-cap.description: zw-brain: WebUI core scenario page count cap (design contract). v4.1 二轮再砍后包含 P1-P5/P7（核心旅程）+ B1.1/B1.2（后台支撑面）。Computed from current authoritative baseline (v4 → v3 → v2 fallback).
zwbrain.webui-pages-cap.compute: if [ -f docs/approved/zw-brain-architecture.md ]; then awk '/^### 5\.2 /{flag=1; next} /^### |^## /{flag=0} flag' docs/approved/zw-brain-architecture.md | grep -cE '^\| (\*\*)?(P[0-9]+|B[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)'; elif [ -f docs/approved/zw-brain-architecture-v3.md ]; then awk '/^### 5\.2 /{flag=1; next} /^### |^## /{flag=0} flag' docs/approved/zw-brain-architecture-v3.md | grep -cE '^\| P[0-9]+'; elif [ -f docs/approved/zw-brain-architecture-v2.md ]; then awk '/^### 5\.2 /{flag=1; next} /^### |^## /{flag=0} flag' docs/approved/zw-brain-architecture-v2.md | grep -cE '^\| P[0-9]+'; else echo 0; fi

legacy.import.schemas.description: Number of mysqldump schemas under old/10示例数据/ (each *.sql = one schema dump). Dumps are .gitignored — when absent (e.g. CI runner), compute outputs empty and sync-stats skips this key with a WARN, preserving local drift-detection without false-positive in CI.
legacy.import.schemas.compute: if ls 'old/10示例数据/'*.sql >/dev/null 2>&1; then ls 'old/10示例数据/'*.sql | wc -l | tr -d ' '; fi

legacy.import.tables-total.description: Total CREATE TABLE count across all dump files (raw — includes shadow/copy tables; the importer filters at mapper level). grep -a forces text mode because some dumps contain stray bytes that trip grep's binary heuristic. Empty when dumps absent (see schemas).
legacy.import.tables-total.compute: if ls 'old/10示例数据/'*.sql >/dev/null 2>&1; then for f in 'old/10示例数据/'*.sql; do grep -ac '^CREATE TABLE' "$f"; done | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'; fi

legacy.import.record-classes.description: Count of SQLAlchemy Record classes in zw_brain/domain/models.py (the canonical model surface).

legacy.import.missing-records.description: Count of M-numbered rows in legacy-import-mapping §二 missing-record table (M1, M2, ... — items the mapping doc flags as not yet covered by a Record class).

legacy.import.missing-resolved.description: Count of M1–M6 records (the §二 'P2 blocking' subset) actually present in domain/models.py — once this hits 6, the mapping doc's blocking note is fully discharged.

zwbrain.capability-budget-j1.description: zw-brain: J1 找数→用数 旅程 live capability 数（design contract per-journey budget）。drift = registry 边界变更，需走 GATE 决策。
zwbrain.capability-budget-j1.compute: if [ -d zw_brain/skill_registration/registered ]; then python3 -c "import json,glob; print(sum(1 for p in glob.glob('zw_brain/skill_registration/registered/*.json') for d in [json.load(open(p))] if (d.get('product_scope') or {}).get('journey')=='j1' and (d.get('product_scope') or {}).get('status')=='live'))"; else echo 0; fi

zwbrain.capability-budget-j2.description: zw-brain: J2 挂数→维数 旅程 live capability 数（design contract per-journey budget）。drift = registry 边界变更。
zwbrain.capability-budget-j2.compute: if [ -d zw_brain/skill_registration/registered ]; then python3 -c "import json,glob; print(sum(1 for p in glob.glob('zw_brain/skill_registration/registered/*.json') for d in [json.load(open(p))] if (d.get('product_scope') or {}).get('journey')=='j2' and (d.get('product_scope') or {}).get('status')=='live'))"; else echo 0; fi

zwbrain.capability-budget-b1.description: zw-brain: B1 后台支撑面（合规与运营 + 平台接入与扩展）live capability 数。drift = registry 边界变更。
zwbrain.capability-budget-b1.compute: if [ -d zw_brain/skill_registration/registered ]; then python3 -c "import json,glob; print(sum(1 for p in glob.glob('zw_brain/skill_registration/registered/*.json') for d in [json.load(open(p))] if (d.get('product_scope') or {}).get('journey')=='b1' and (d.get('product_scope') or {}).get('status')=='live'))"; else echo 0; fi

zwbrain.capability-budget-infra.description: zw-brain: infra 底座（鉴权 / 审计 / actor / adapter health 等）live capability 数。drift = 底座边界变更。
zwbrain.capability-budget-infra.compute: if [ -d zw_brain/skill_registration/registered ]; then python3 -c "import json,glob; print(sum(1 for p in glob.glob('zw_brain/skill_registration/registered/*.json') for d in [json.load(open(p))] if (d.get('product_scope') or {}).get('journey')=='infra' and (d.get('product_scope') or {}).get('status')=='live'))"; else echo 0; fi
